currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful Commons2007 whole church, drum/relief and bell-tower photographs plus current standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Photographs viewed only, not downloaded or redistributed. No bespoke plans/surveys researched. Old reference date, exact current roof finish and tower separation remain explicit limits.

pictures.author: Lidia Ilona
pictures.observed: Inspected close church exterior: tall polygonal drum with narrow slit windows framed by shallow nested round blind arcades; gray-tan ashlar and geometric/interlace cornice bands. Silver standing-seam cross-gabled roofs, large shallow facade arcades, paired circular rosette reliefs and a central relief cross under a gable. Exact medieval figures/interlace/inscriptions are simplified.

pictures.author: Lidia Ilona
pictures.observed: Inspected whole church exterior: compact tall stone body with cross gables, tall polygonal windowed drum, silver conical metal roof and small cross. Narrow lower window slits, three unequal blind arcades on gable face, small projecting porch/door with low roof. Stone varies warm tan/gray; grass slopes against base. Exact modern roof finish/terrain remains unverified from this2007 photograph.

pictures.author: miss_rubov / Monika
pictures.observed: Inspected three-storey stone campanile beside church: lower closed arched glazing/door, tall open middle arches with thick corner piers and cornice, narrower open upper arcade with round columns, silver hipped roof/cross. Church is visible nearby behind it, but this crop does not establish exact separation or map position. Western mapped projection is an explicit approximate partition; no independently identified bell footprint claimed.
